title: Talking to the GC / Builder
short_answer: Be respectful, be specific, and leave with a written next step — never a hallway maybe.
plain_words: Be respectful. Be clear. Do not invent scope. Do not quote square footage or "1-side / 2-side" language from internal scope reviews to a client. Extra work needs written authorization from someone who can actually authorize it — another sub never can.
when_to_use: Before committing GVC to schedule or scope changes on site
When the GC asks for extras or disagrees with the packet
Daily coordination that could become a CO or RFI
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting

steps.title: Allowed: schedule coordination, access questions
steps.body: Allowed: schedule coordination, access questions, pointing at drawings, "I need to check with the office before we add that."

steps.title: Not allowed: promising free extras, agreeing to
steps.body: Not allowed: promising free extras, agreeing to revision work without a CO path, guessing fire ratings, inventing return depths.

steps.title: Never say we'll "just take care of it" for work not on our drawings
steps.body: that phrase is how unpaid days start.

steps.title: Client-facing language: do not paste internal sc
steps.body: Client-facing language: do not paste internal scope-review SF or 1-side/2-side phrasing into emails or verbal scope — those are internal (Job Start scrub rule).

steps.title: Residential verbal changes need the same stop-ph
steps.body: Residential verbal changes need the same stop-photo-write-call discipline as commercial — documentation matters more when the process is informal (see Reading Drawings res vs comm).

steps.title: Who authorizes: GC PM / superintendent / owner rep per contract
steps.body: not the electrician, not "the guy who asked nicely." Escalate via Escalation Ladder.

quality_checks.prompt: Talking to the GC / Builder: steps followed and documented

common_mistakes.title: Argue on site without paper
common_mistakes.wrong: Verbal only when scope is contested
common_mistakes.right: Confirm in writing / photo / CO path

common_mistakes.title: Promise without authority
common_mistakes.wrong: Commit GVC to work you cannot authorize
common_mistakes.right: Escalate when money or schedule moves
common_mistakes.why: Trust and margin both take hits

next_steps.why: Document extras before you do them
